title: delphinium scopulorum subsp. occidentale
intro: Delphinium scopulorum subsp. occidentale, commonly known as Rocky Mountain delphinium, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Ranunculaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include treating various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Delphinium scopulorum subsp. occidentale are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which help alleviate pain and improve breathing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
